title: Rulon G. Craven
vital_facts: Born 1924 Murray, Utah (Raised in Boise, Idaho)
Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man.
Mission to Maori People in New Zealand
Married Donna Lunt, Mesa Arizona Temple; 1953; six children
Bishop, Counselor to Stake Presidency, Regional Representative
President of New Zealand north Mission
